title: Prefer explicit value parameters and isolated single-component tasks when Venus2 wide-vector RTL transport is unproven
proposed_rule: For a Gem5-correct Venus2 task that depends on task-local DSPM vector scratch, repeated aliases of one wide input, or multiple simultaneous wide accumulation/return chains, do not infer RTL safety from a barrier or from the first correct output. First prefer scheduler-loaded immutable value parameters and register-only operations. If the combined task still has an RTL-only second-chain failure, split it into a reusable single-component task and compare every visible output. Treat this as a backend-scoped search rule, not a universal Venus language restriction.
scope: Venus2 tasks with 448-lane i16 inputs/outputs, task-local vector scratch, repeated wide arguments or parallel component chains

negative_candidates.observation: ABI input materialization and vstore dumps were correct, but the dependent task-local DSPM vload returned zero and task 3 was the first failing boundary.
The pure-VRF transport task passed, while the next frontend task loaded scalar-built DSPM interpolation maps as zero; task 4 was the first failing boundary.
Explicit scheduler-loaded interpolation maps made the first real accumulation output exact, but the paired imaginary accumulation output contained 864 unknown bytes and all downstream outputs failed.

implementation_proposal: Add a static warning for task-local DSPM addresses consumed by vector vload/vstore when no backend qualification receipt is attached.
Flag repeated wide BAS arguments and multiple wide returns as RTL-isolation search candidates, not compile errors.
Require per-port RTL comparison, including unknown-byte accounting, before accepting the combined task.
Allow single-component task splitting only when measured whole-DAG performance remains within its frozen gate.
validation_before_promotion: Build reduced positive and negative probes that isolate repeated-argument delivery from dual-return register pressure.
Repeat the DSPM scratch round-trip probe on an independent task and at least one additional RTL digest.
Confirm that the proposed warning does not reject the already qualified PDCCH scratch patterns that have direct fresh-RTL evidence.
promotion_gate: REVIEW_REQUIRED; this proposal does not edit live knowledge and cannot self-promote
rollback: Remove the proposed static warning/search heuristic. The qualified PBCH single-component DAG and its immutable RTL evidence remain valid.
